title: Pure Unchained
summary: Pure Unchained destruction and Link control deck, comprised of DARK and FIRE Fiends that actively destroy their own cards to trigger explosive floating summons from the Deck. The archetype specializes in stealing opposing monsters to perform non-consensual Link Summons on both players' turns.

summary.title: Starters
points: Abomination's Prison searches any Unchained card from your Deck, and Special Summons an Unchained monster from Deck if destroyed while Set.
Unchained Twins - Aruha targets and destroys another card you control to Special Summon itself from your hand, locking you into Fiends for the turn.
Unchained Twins - Rakea destroys a card you control as a Quick Effect to trigger destruction floats on either turn.

Unchained Soul of Sharvara destroys a card you control or a face-up Fiend as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself from hand, and Sets an Unchained Spell or Trap directly from the Deck when sent to the GY.
All Unchained Twins (Aruha, Rakea, Sarama) Special Summon an Unchained monster from the Deck when destroyed by battle or card effect.

summary.title: Opening: Aruha + Set Trap
steps: Set Escape of the Unchained (or Abominable Chamber of the Unchained) in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Activate Unchained Twins - Aruha in hand, targeting your Set Trap to destroy it and Special Summon Aruha.
The destroyed Trap triggers in GY, Special Summoning Unchained Soul of Sharvara from your Deck.
Link Summon Unchained Soul Lord of Yama using Aruha and Sharvara.
Trigger both Yama and Sharvara simultaneously: Sharvara Sets Abominable Chamber from Deck, and Yama adds Unchained Twins - Sarama (or Abominable Unchained Soul) to hand.
Normal Summon Sarama, setting back Escape from GY and destroying Chamber to trigger Chamber's GY effect, fielding bodies into Unchained Soul of Rage.

summary.title: Bosses & Link Theft
points: Unchained Soul of Rage targets 1 face-up opponent monster during their Main Phase as a Quick Effect and uses it along with itself to Link Summon a DARK Link Monster (such as Unchained Soul of Anguish or S:P Little Knight).
Unchained Soul of Anguish targets an opponent's face-up monster during your Main Phase to Link Summon a DARK Link Monster (such as Unchained Abomination).

Unchained Abomination automatically destroys a card on the field whenever a card is destroyed by card effect, destroys an opponent card when a monster is destroyed by battle, and pops another card during the End Phase.
Unchained Soul Lord of Yama searches an Unchained monster on summon, and banishes itself from the GY when a card you control is destroyed to revive a Fiend monster and destroy 1 card you control.
Abominable Unchained Soul Special Summons itself from hand when a card you control is destroyed and discards 1 card to destroy any card on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Escape of the Unchained destroys 1 Unchained monster you control and 1 card the opponent controls, triggering your destroyed monster's floating summon.
Abominable Chamber of the Unchained Special Summons an Unchained monster from your hand or GY, and summons from Deck if destroyed while Set.
Wailing of the Unchained Souls destroys 1 card on the field immediately whenever you Link Summon an Unchained Link Monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Future OCG support cards (such as Unchained Malevolent Magistrate Kamura, Unchained Ogre Shara, and Unchained Enma Lord Yama) are excluded from this TCG profile to adhere to current tournament card availability.
